questions.question: Orient verdicts are in the trace (BK-384 constrains, so any change to the fix shapes owes its dossier a dated note; BK-366, BK-404/ID-266 and ID-268 are unrelated, and BK-404/ID-266 overlap only as a rebase risk with your gate PR). What scope should BK-430 take?

options.label: Both, at the decision (Recommended)
options.description: P3: one clause in /ship triage and /fix-pr Step 3. Any close that rests on a check (shape (3), a Refute's evidence, or a row marked covered) must name a check that could have returned the claim false. A wording grep or shape check closes nothing alone. P2: a rule in /ship's tuning paragraph: a change justified by spend also compares the defects shipped against its baseline. One new ADR amending ADR-0033, plus a dated note in BK-384's dossier.

options.label: P3 now, P2 decided against
options.description: Ship the falsifiable-check clause only. Record P2 as decided against in BACKLOG-DONE: most deliveries have no twin to compare defects with, so the comparison only exists in experiments, and roadmap step 3 already measures units, rounds and defects there. Smaller diff, but done-criterion 1 then rests on that reason.

options.label: P3 now, P2 to step 3
options.description: Ship P3 and split P2 into the measurement item that roadmap step 3 files, where a baseline actually exists. BK-430 closes on P3 alone, and P2 stays open until that item decides it.

options.label: Both, P2 as a principle
options.description: P2 becomes a CLAUDE.md principle that applies to all work, not only /ship tuning. Widest reach, but the process budget has to absorb it (cut elsewhere or record a raise), and every session pays for it in context.

questions.question: The process budget is at exactly 294945 of 294945 bytes, so any growth in /ship or /fix-pr fails the gate. The text P3 and P2 need in the skills should come to roughly 1–1.5 KB (estimate; the reasoning goes in the new ADR). How should BK-430 pay for it?

options.label: Cut first, raise the rest (Recommended)
options.description: Offset the growth by tightening the sections I'm editing anyway (triage, fix-shape owes, the tuning paragraph). Any remainder that would cost a load-bearing reason is recorded as a raise against BK-430, with the reason in the register.

options.label: Record a raise
options.description: Add the clauses as written and record one raise of about 1–1.5 KB under BK-430. Simplest diff. If your gate PR also raises, the two will conflict on process-budget.json and the second to merge re-runs --raise.

options.label: Strict net zero
options.description: No raise at all: cut elsewhere in the 19 files until the total holds. More scope, and it touches text outside BK-430's subject.
